name: Hawa Wakana
source: A college student working part-time at a video game retailer who loves writing novels. She used to upload her work on the Internet, and in the past, she had received an offer for her work to be officially published. However, she could not bear the excessive interference from the publisher and eventually turned them down. It became a traumatic event for her, so she now thinks of writing novels as just a hobby. She wears loose clothes to conceal her chest, but is still unable to hide it completely.
